Past Events

21 Jun 2026

Robocon 2026 Hong Kong Contest

Share this news

Date

21 Jun 2026

Time

12:30 – 18:00 (GMT+8)

Venue

Grand Hall, Building 12W, Hong Kong Science Park

Organised by Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation, Robocon 2026 Hong Kong Contest continues to unite strong alliances to grow and promote Hong Kong’s next generation of skilled engineering, AI and robotics talents. In collaboration with the Hong Kong Institution of Engineers, the Hong Kong Computer Society, and Radio Television Hong Kong, Robocon Hong Kong 2026 will be held at Grand Hall, Hong Kong Science Park on Sunday 21 June 2026.

Each year, regional champions compete at the international finale to win the ABU Asia-Pacific Robot Contest (ABU Robocon). This year, with Hong Kong proudly as the official host, the two top-ranked teams from the local contest will represent Hong Kong on our home turf at the ABU Asia-Pacific Robot Contest (ABU Robocon) in August 2026.

The theme for 2026 is “Kung Fu Quest”, a dynamic challenge inspired by traditional martial arts that combines thrilling fighting spirit with cutting-edge robotics and automation. We are incredibly proud to have Hong Kong’s renowned institutions participating in the contest, promising another year of intense competition, AI-integrated robot designs and sportsmanship.

Click here to watch live on YouTube starting from 15:30 on 21 June!
